items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
Fuel can leak from the tank crossover pipe (recall)
items.job: Replace left and right fuel tanks (recall)

items.t: Center brake light can stop working (recall)
Dead 12V battery from audio unit staying on
items.job: Charge and test 12V battery, update audio unit software
items.note: If the battery was damaged by running flat, a new 12V battery adds roughly $150-$300.

items.t: Won't start on first press of the start button
items.job: Diagnose no-start and apply Acura bulletin repair
items.note: Price is for diagnosis. Some 2017 cars have a warranty extension that may cover the repair.

items.t: Power system won't start from a blown fuse
items.job: Diagnose blown fuse B5 and repair the cause
items.note: Price covers diagnosis and the fuse; the part that caused the fuse to blow can cost more.

items.t: Rattle from the door tweeter area
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.job: Repair or replace EPS control unit
items.note: Owners report about $500 for a module repair and about $1,600 for a new Acura module. A seized steering rack costs more.

items.t: Timing belt and water pump overdue
items.job: Replace timing belt, water pump and tensioner; adjust valves
items.note: Owners report totals of about $1,800-$2,600 at specialists and dealers.
Owners report about $2,500 for a clutch job.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP system fault
items.job: Diagnose EVAP leak and replace failed part
items.note: Price covers diagnosis; RepairPal lists NSX check engine light diagnosis at about $153-$224. The failed part adds to that.
